correctness.rationale: The one-edge case follows by quadratic integration and two edges form a circle. For m>=3 the chosen edge and a shortest other edge have a constant circle integral; all third-edge contributions are concave in candidate coordinate with equal integrated endpoint values and a uniform centered positive-measure gap, proving strictness. Integrating the hub distances proves the formula for all positive lengths including ties. Exact algebra and direct quadrature checks passed.
